scope:
Controlled stop screening with frozen-target and active-feedback comparators.

Fixture pose is used only for initialization and evaluation. Approach commands
are timed; corrective feedback uses onboard estimates. This is a screening
experiment, not deployment qualification of any comparator.

uncertainty_calibration.scope: reference-policy episode bound under exchangeability; control feedback/domain shift require fresh validation

pose_graph.method: root-anchored SE3 graph, robust sparse least squares

localization.uncertainty_scope: conditional filter plus path/innovation drift allowance; not a calibrated probability guarantee
